boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Dayton
boards.description: Ten currently documented food and convenience destinations with evening or overnight availability around the University of Dayton.

cards.title: The Emporium
cards.subtitle: Marianist Hall, University of Dayton
cards.notes: Use the just-walk-out convenience store for packaged food, drinks or deli items when regular service has ended; check the weekly maintenance window first.
cards.short_summary: A campus convenience store with overnight access.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists The Emporium as open 24/7, except 3–7 a.m. Wednesdays for software updates.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 except 3–7 a.m. Wednesdays for software updates; operating hours may change for holidays, breaks and special events.

cards.title: The Emporium Deli
cards.subtitle: Inside The Emporium, Marianist Hall
cards.notes: Plan a weekday made-to-order stop before the deli closes, or use the surrounding Emporium convenience store after deli service ends.
cards.short_summary: The full-service deli within Marianist Hall’s Emporium.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists Emporium Deli hours as 10:30 a.m.–9 p.m. weekdays and noon–6:30 p.m. weekends.
cards.access_notes: Deli: 10:30 a.m.–9 p.m. Monday–Friday; noon–6:30 p.m. Saturday–Sunday. The adjacent Emporium has separate 24/7 access.

cards.title: The Grainary
cards.subtitle: Virginia W. Kettering Hall, University of Dayton
cards.notes: Head to VWK for an on-campus dinner stop with sandwiches, salads, snacks and desserts; make the trip before its listed 10 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: VWK dining with service through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists The Grainary open until 10 p.m. every day, with different weekday and weekend opening times.
cards.access_notes: Open 8 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Friday and 9 a.m.–10 p.m. Saturday–Sunday; hours may change during breaks or special events.

cards.title: Marycrest Dining
cards.subtitle: Marycrest Complex, University of Dayton
cards.notes: Use the Marycrest dining room for an evening meal before 10 p.m.; review campus dining updates when a break or special event is underway.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining room open nightly to 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists Marycrest Dining open until 10 p.m. on weekdays and weekends.
cards.access_notes: Open 7 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Friday and 9 a.m.–10 p.m. Saturday–Sunday; hours may change during breaks or special events.

cards.title: Milano's University of Dayton
cards.subtitle: 1834 Brown Street, Dayton
cards.notes: Check the day before heading to Brown Street: the restaurant’s official location page lists late closing times and separate delivery hours.
cards.short_summary: A Brown Street restaurant with late official hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Milano's lists its University of Dayton restaurant at 1834 Brown Street, open until midnight Sunday and 1–2:30 a.m. Monday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours: Sunday 11 a.m.–midnight; Monday–Wednesday 11 a.m.–1 a.m.; Thursday–Saturday 11 a.m.–2:30 a.m. Delivery hours differ.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Brown Street
cards.subtitle: 1000 Brown Street, Dayton
cards.notes: For a very late Brown Street food stop, confirm whether you need dine-in or drive-thru access; the official page posts different closing times.
cards.short_summary: Brown Street Taco Bell with overnight posted hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists the 1000 Brown Street drive-thru open until 6 a.m. daily and dine-in open until 3 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 9 a.m.–6 a.m. daily. Dine-in: 9 a.m.–3 a.m. on the posted schedule. Verify hours before travel.

cards.title: Jimmy John's on Brown Street
cards.subtitle: 1157 Brown Street, Dayton
cards.notes: Use the store’s online ordering or pickup options for a sandwich stop, particularly Thursday through Saturday when the official page lists later hours.
cards.short_summary: A Brown Street sandwich shop with 2 a.m. weekend-adjacent hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John’s lists its 1157 Brown Street location open until 2 a.m. Thursday, Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday and until 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; delivery hours are listed on the same page.

cards.title: Subway on Brown Street
cards.subtitle: 1103 Brown Street, Dayton
cards.notes: Build a sandwich, wrap or salad before the posted 10 p.m. close; order ahead or use in-store dining, pickup or delivery as needed.
cards.short_summary: A Brown Street sandwich option open nightly to 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway’s official page lists the 1103 Brown Street restaurant open 9 a.m.–10 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Store hours are 9 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday through Sunday; pickup, delivery and in-restaurant dining are listed.

cards.title: Chipotle on Brown Street
cards.subtitle: 1211 Brown Street, Dayton
cards.notes: Choose a customizable burrito, bowl, taco, salad or quesadilla before the 11 p.m. close; pickup and delivery are listed by the location.
cards.short_summary: A Brown Street customizable-meal option open to 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle’s official location page lists the restaurant at 1211 Brown Street open 10:45 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours: 10:45 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday–Sunday. In-store pickup and delivery are listed as available.

cards.title: Wendy's on Wayne Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1507 Wayne Avenue, Dayton
cards.notes: If you are using this Dayton location late, verify the restaurant and drive-thru schedule on the official locator before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A Dayton fast-food location listing 3 a.m. daily closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists its 1507 Wayne Avenue restaurant and drive-thru open until 3 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru hours are listed as 6:30 a.m.–3 a.m. Monday–Sunday. Holiday hours may vary.

warnings: Campus dining notes that operating hours may change during holidays, breaks and special events; confirm before visiting.
